next.reason: 1985: "If the ON SIZE ERROR phrase is not specified ... the values of the affected resultant identifiers are undefined."; 2023: "the EC-SIZE-TRUNCATION exception condition is set to exist; and processing proceeds as specified in 14.6.13.1.3, Fatal exception conditions.". Without SIZE ERROR, 1985 leaves values undefined and goes to the statement end; 2023 raises a fatal EC-SIZE exception. 2023 also adds a size error for nonzero results nearer to zero.
